#SBATCH --job-name=tmol-dun-lookup

#SBATCH --gpus=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=4
#SBATCH --mem=32G
#SBATCH --time=00:30:00

set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/home/kdidi/projects/tmol-pr503-review
export PYTHONPATH=.
export TMOL_USE_JIT=1
export TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=9.0
export MAX_JOBS=4
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=2
export SPARSE_AUTO_DENSIFY=1
export TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR=/mnt/home/kdidi/tmol-pr503-results/extensions-candidate
apptainer exec --nv --bind /mnt:/mnt /mnt/data/kdidi/apptainers/latent-dev-cuda13-26.06-tmol0.1.54.sif python -m pytest -q tmol/tests/score/dunbrack tmol/tests/pack/rotamer/dunbrack tmol/tests/database/scoring/test_dunbrack_mirroring_metadata.py tmol/tests/database/scoring/test_mirrored_library_scope.py tmol/tests/pack/test_mirror_packing.py --junitxml=/mnt/home/kdidi/tmol-pr503-followup/dun-lookup-gpu.xml
